verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows an Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server that lets external AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) interact with Gusto's API for developers building integrations — this is a developer-facing tool, not a built-in AI assistant inside the Gusto product for end-users to delegate payroll/HR tasks. No evidence of an in-app AI assistant for running payroll, answering HR questions, or automating tasks for end users.
